plugins.description: Talk with your BB coding agents using Codex subscription voice for Codex and Claude threads.
plugins.overview:
Talk with Codex or Claude in your BB thread using Codex subscription voice. Tandem keeps the conversation connected as you navigate.

## What you get

Start from the waveform beside dictation, including on New thread. Mute and circular hang-up controls stay visible during a call; a floating dial follows you off-thread. The waveform pulses when connected and glows during assistant playback. End voice while coding work continues, and use BB’s thread controls to cancel agent work. Tool approvals remain in BB.

Optionally enable Cached briefing to retain bounded completed speech privately and supply a prepared reference when a call starts. Saved speech is limited to 20 calls for seven days; no audio is stored. Missing or stale briefings leave the call retrieval-only. Briefings use your Codex subscription and remain local to your BB installation.

## Requirements

Tandem is an experimental developer preview. It uses Codex signed in with ChatGPT on the BB server, with no API-key fallback. Claude retains its existing provider authentication. Native Codex voice requires the customized BB native transport bridge; new-thread startup requires input-free initialization support. General stock-BB compatibility is not established. Codex protocol changes may require updates. Physical-device audio routing and background behavior need further testing.

The display name is Tandem; the stable plugin ID remains live-voice to preserve settings and saved data.

plugins.description: Recent threads on the new-thread page, with nested threads and live activity.
plugins.overview:
## Keep recent work within reach

Open the new-thread page to find your latest conversations alongside the
composer. On desktop the list sits below it; on compact screens it scrolls
above it.

Recents keeps child threads nested under their parents, lets you collapse
branches, and shows live status, unsent drafts, provider icons and workspace
metadata. Thread rows keep BB's own actions menu. The list shows up to fifteen
visible rows.

Creating a thread shows progress and highlights the result when you stay on
the new-thread page. Navigating to a nested thread or receiving unread activity
reveals its ancestors. Existing browser collapse preferences carry over from
the original core implementation.

## Requirements

Requires BB with Plugin SDK 0.6.147 or later, including the companion homepage
section changes. No external service or additional account is required. The
plugin works independently of Tandem.

Use `bb recents list --json` for a bounded snapshot through the CLI. Browser
collapse choices and local drafts remain specific to that client.

plugins.description: Personal backgrounds, Capy dithering, and six saved slots for your conversations.
plugins.overview:
## Personal backgrounds

Use a custom image or Capy pixel pattern behind conversations and the new-thread page. Six saved slots let you switch between backgrounds. Apply a background to all threads or keep it on the new-thread page.

## This fork

Based on Mateo Cerquetella’s Aura, this edition adds warped blue-noise dithering, an animated half-wallpaper fade, image caching improvements, and readable composer and recent-thread surfaces on desktop and compact screens. Original licensing and third-party notices are included.

## Requirements

Requires BB with content-script support. No external account or paid service is required. Background images and settings remain on your BB installation.

[Source and installation](https://github.com/jshph/bb-extensions/tree/main/plugins/aura)
